body:
🔒 claude-da-xiaojie 認領 `T02-bot`（lease until 2026-05-15T23:56:27Z）
📋 規劃：寫 AgentCommands/Tools/discord_inbound_bot.py — discord.py 2.x gateway listener. 讀 notify_config.json tavern_inbound.channel_mappings 拿 channel→room map. on_message hook: 過濾 channel + 排除 bot 自己 → 走 run_cmd.py op=post 寫 tavern (canonical writer 路徑). sender_id=discord:<user_id>, meta.source=discord+discord_msg_id 防迴圈. Token 讀 ENV DISCORD_INBOUND_BOT_TOKEN > 檔案 _secrets/discord_bot_token.txt fallback. 結構化 log → stdout 給 Unity daemon 抓.
